summary: Read-only weekly check of kinz-competitor-intelligence's published scrape data. Release is 7d16h old (just under the 8-day staleness bar) at 1,255 products across 9 of 77 competitors. The batch-2 scrape persistence bug is still happening, reconfirmed for a 6th+ consecutive week (fix needs .github/workflows/scrape.yml, out of agent reach). The 2026-10-12 scheduled scrape run additionally failed outright on a recurring playwright/firefox version-drift bug before it could even test PR #71's seed-resurrection fix, so no new release went out this week. No pagination regression, no new price-movement signal (price_history still only holds a single snapshot date). Wrote the new findings/kci-data-quality.md section. One privacy near-miss self-reported by the subagent: a SELECT * join incidentally pulled a contact_person/phone/email value into its own tool-result scratchpad while checking a timestamp; it did not write it to the findings file or this report and verified it was not reused.
errors: Privacy near-miss (not a breach): subagent's SELECT * on scraping_logs JOIN competitors incidentally surfaced one competitor's contact_person/phone/email in its own transcript; not propagated to findings file, this run record, or any output. Flagging for awareness -- future runs of this job should SELECT explicit non-PII columns only, never *, when joining the competitors table.
